All-base deletions relative to E2 in 226 strains

Each row is a strain and each column a window along the E2 chromosomes; the colour is the fraction of the window's uniquely mappable bases that are deleted in that strain. Move the mouse over the map to read the values. Click to pin a red line and click it again to remove it; the arrow keys move a pinned line by one window. Select a chromosome to view it at full width.
